_comment: Every outside repository this system was built from. scripts/instalar_fuentes.py reads this file. kind=skill: installed with `npx skills add <repo> -a claude-code -y --copy` into .claude/skills/ (project level, tracked by skills-lock.json). kind=repo: shallow clone into tools/ (reference material, not a skill). Names in `skills` are the CURRENT upstream names (several were renamed upstream; `formerly` shows the older local name).

groups.core: Web research (Agent Reach), Remotion skills, browser tooling. Recommended for everyone.
groups.design: Design-quality skills and the DESIGN.md collection used to build and review design systems.

sources.name: Agent Reach
sources.used_for: Reading the public internet for references and research (YouTube, Instagram, X, Reddit, GitHub, web pages, RSS...). Used by design-references-research and luisart-procesar-referencias.
sources.note: Its CLI checks the machine read-only by default; `--system` installs only after the user explicitly approves. Use the no-login channels; login/cookie channels only if the user sets them up themselves.

sources.name: Remotion agent skills
sources.license: see the repository (Remotion itself has its own license: free for individuals and small teams)
sources.used_for: Best practices for building video in Remotion (router skill + captions, render, studio, multimedia, SaaS, maps, upgrade...).

sources.name: Playwright CLI skill
sources.used_for: Checking designs in a real browser (phone and desktop, light and dark) before delivering.

sources.name: Taste skills (design direction)
sources.used_for: Setting the design direction (taste), redesigning, brutalist look, brand kits, and making sure outputs are complete.

sources.name: Impeccable (design critique and audit)
sources.used_for: `/impeccable critique` and `/impeccable audit` before delivering any design.

sources.name: awesome-design-md (DESIGN.md collection)
sources.used_for: Reference DESIGN.md files of well-known brands: borrow principles, not identity (see design-system-import).

sources.name: img2threejs
sources.used_for: Turning an image into a Three.js 3D scene, only when 3D graphics are requested.
